scripts.start: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently "npm --prefix auth-service run start:dev" "npm --prefix blog-service run start:dev" "npm --prefix media-service run start:dev" "npm --prefix api-gateway run start:dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start:backend: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently "npm --prefix auth-service run start:dev" "npm --prefix blog-service run start:dev" "npm --prefix media-service run start:dev" "npm --prefix api-gateway run start:dev"
scripts.sonar:check: npm run sonar && npm run sonar:gate
scripts.coverage:all: npm run test:cov --prefix auth-service && npm run test:cov --prefix blog-service && npm run test:cov --prefix media-service && npm run test:cov --prefix api-gateway && npm run test:cov --prefix frontend && npm run coverage:python
scripts.sonar:full: npm run coverage:all && npm run sonar:check
